# Ashwood User-Supplied Asset Sources

This directory contains the 34 assets retained from the user-supplied Sketchfab
download set received on 29 July 2026. Provenance was recovered from the
top-level `asset.extras` object embedded in each GLB JSON chunk. MD5 values were
calculated from the retained files in this directory.

All retained assets are licensed under
[CC BY 4.0](http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Credit the named
author, link the source and license, and indicate project modifications where
applicable.

## Additional attribution note

The Sketchfab description for `bookshelf.glb` identifies it as based on Brandon
Westlake's "Chocolate Beech Bookshelf (FREE)", also under CC BY. Preserve that
upstream credit alongside the embedded Idmenthal credit when the asset is used.

## Excluded source files

The following files from the supplied set were intentionally not retained:

- `dusty_old_bookshelf_free.glb` and `retro_computer_setup_free.glb` use the
  Sketchfab Standard License, which does not permit distributing the raw asset
  as a standalone file in a public source repository.
- `school_desk (1).glb` is CC BY-SA 4.0 and duplicates the retained CC BY 4.0
  `school_desk.glb`; it was excluded to avoid unnecessary ShareAlike handling.
- `window.glb` is untextured and split across 90 meshes; the retained textured
  `doublewindow.glb` is a better-performing substitute.
- `house_door_white.glb` is untextured, while the retained door set provides
  textured alternatives.
- `office_drawer.glb` splits a single prop across 121 meshes; the retained file
  cabinets cover the same role with much lower scene overhead.
- `low_poly__sofa.glb` was excluded because its simplified style does not meet
  the environment's realism target.
- `house_door.glb` was excluded as a redundant, low-resolution door variant;
  the retained classroom, hospital and wood doors provide stronger alternatives.
